description: AI Visibility (Site Insights): how ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity answer about the customer's brand. Opt-in: action consent (on true/false) first. action status (default). brands, brand_save (brandId to update; name, domain, category, description, country, language, aliases, competitors [{name, domain}], engines, schedule), brand_delete, brand_status (active|paused), schedule (off|daily|weekly|monthly, engines), prompts, suggest_prompts (templates free; useModel true writes ideas with a low-cost model after confirm), prompts_save (add [{text, category}], update [{id, text, category, active}], remove [ids]), preview (cost and whether a run may start), run (audit now after confirm), results (score trend, mentions, sentiment, competitor table, citations, gaps, recommendations, AI crawler hits), transcripts (full answers; runId, engine, promptId), export (kind answers|mentions|citations|runs|competitors, format csv|json), llms_txt (check + draft), site_check (robots.txt AI bots, llms.txt, structured data on cited own pages). Writes and paid runs return a proposal for oma_confirm_tool.

action.description: status (default), consent or a brand action.

aliases.description: brand_save: other names for the brand.

category.description: brand_save: what it sells, e.g. web hosting.

country.description: brand_save: ISO country code, e.g. FI.

description.description: brand_save: one or two sentences about the brand.

domain.description: brand_save: the brand's own domain, e.g. example.fi.

language.description: brand_save: prompt language, e.g. fi, en, sv.

on.description: consent: true turns AI Visibility on, false off.

runId.description: results / transcripts / export: a run id (default latest).

serviceId.description: Same as siteId, by the website's service id.

siteId.description: One site's Insights (insights site id): lists show only its brands; a new brand is bound to it and pre-filled from it.

useModel.description: suggest_prompts: true writes ideas with a low-cost model (confirm).

name: oma_ai_visibility
title: AI Visibility
